authorization.authorized_action: create a self-contained clean checkout from the pinned Git objects, build baseline and balanced exact-case benchmark binaries, temporarily quiesce the cell containers for correctness and ABBA timing, then restore and verify the original attached AWGN baseline
authorization.authorization_basis: the Phase 3C10 timing violation is committed at 4d329b8, the Phase 3C11 source audit and benchmark protocol are committed at 61c5eb2, and the quiescence-and-rollback runner passes 78 tests at profile revision 3a27ae9

clean_checkout_preparation.method: git clone --no-local of the pinned main repository and each already-present pinned submodule repository, followed by detached checkout of each exact revision

preflight_and_stopping_rules: stop before copying or building on any profile-file checksum, OAI revision, submodule revision, compose checksum, architecture or clean-checkout mismatch
stop if any Git alternates are present in the main checkout or either submodule
allow only the benchmark/test patch in baseline and only the benchmark/test plus balanced-partition patch in optimized
build both conditions before quiescing the live cell
stop on any configure, compile or correctness-test failure
once either cell container is stopped, always run the mandatory restore path
require original gNB and UE image IDs, zero restart-count change, gNB health and UE attachment after restore
do not build optimized network images or run a network replay regardless of benchmark outcome

post_execution.pass_action: copy and hash raw evidence, evaluate the frozen benchmark rules, commit the result, and only then consider a separate optimized-image build amendment
post_execution.fail_action: keep all network replay and calibration gates closed and continue offline
